title: Ended up using the magnetic part more
text: Ended up using the magnetic part more. You can put a push pin in it or you can put a magnet on it. I thought I would use both equally, but in reality, I hardly ever use the push pin... you kind of have to more it around until you find a hole in the metal for the pin to go through. Much easier to just put a magnet on it. If I had to do over, I would just get a metal board and skip the push pin aspect.
